description: Get the full ticket sales picture, the same numbers as the Ticketing overview page: gross and refunded money, paid orders, tickets sold by type against capacity, check-in rate, waitlist, and orders awaiting approval. Use it for sales questions; use get_registration_stats for a quick count. Returns configured:false when no ticketing rail is bound.

eventId.description: Event id, as returned by list_events.

org.description: Organization slug from list_my_orgs; only needed if you belong to several.

name: get_ticketing_overview

byType.description: Active ticket types in display order.

capacity.description: Total capacity of active ticket types, or null when any is unlimited.

checkInRate.description: Checked-in share of valid tickets (0 to 1), or null.

configured.description: False when no ticketing rail is bound; no other fields follow.

grossCents.description: Gross paid takings in minor units of currency.
